title: Implied efforts in exclusive dealings
summary: The agreement’s structure may imply the effort needed to give an exclusive commercial arrangement its intended operation.
notes: Wood reads exclusivity, contingent compensation, accounting, and related provisions together to imply reasonable efforts. It does not merely insert a favorable obligation because the agreement seems unfair. The casebook compares the sales provision’s “best efforts” wording to the opinion’s “reasonable efforts,” and points to the separate full contract in SEL. Those differences should remain available for interpretation.
